{{Top|leg}}
A '''jump gate accelerator''' was a device that was used with a [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|jump gate]] to propel a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|179|jump gate accelerator}}</ref> Fragments of one such device from the [[Pre-Republic era|era]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] were displayed in the "[[Cradle of the Galaxy]]" [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] museum tour shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref>{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_4.html|New Xim Exhibit to Tour}}</ref>
